description: This file defines various reusable UI components for a React project, including Card, Button, Input, Select, Textarea, and Spinner components. It includes JSX markup and component function definitions.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A functional component that renders a styled card container with optional header including title, subtitle, and actions, and a content area.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A styled button component that accepts children, disabled state, and other button HTML attributes.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled input field component extending React.InputHTMLAttributes with custom className styling.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A styled select dropdown component extending React.SelectHTMLAttributes with custom className styling.

methods.name: Textarea
methods.description: A styled textarea component extending React.TextareaHTMLAttributes with custom className styling.

methods.name: Spinner
methods.description: A simple animated SVG spinner component.
